baseline_prompt_en: Create a full-body historical-performance photograph in a rain-damp 13th-century Kakatiya temple mandapa during a torchlit heritage reenactment. One clearly adult female heritage dancer, her facial appearance guided only by the attached portrait reference, is caught midway through lighting the final brass lamp before a carved stone gateway. She wears a fully opaque indigo silk sari ensemble with a high-neck blouse, fitted underlayer, long draped panels, and ankle bells. Shape her stance as a readable tribhanga: head, ribcage, and hips offset in alternating lateral curves; keep her spine axially elongated while both shoulders rest low and relaxed. Her weight-bearing foot stays planted as the other leg extends behind in a continuous plantar-flexed line through a pointed foot. Show her entire figure and both unobstructed feet on wet flagstones, with amber flames, rain haze, ceremonial drums, and painted stage banners lining the deep colonnade.
